read.en: Corning fell 8.1% on Oct 22 to $123.99, trading between $122.57 and $128.95 on 1.7 times average volume. It is below the falling 5-day ($131.2), 10-day ($138.8), 30-day ($150.0) and 100-day ($165.0) averages and the rising 200-day ($154.5). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and is below zero; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 12 ($149.71), and RSI is 33.
read.zh: 康宁 10月22日下跌 8.1%，收于 $123.99，盘中区间 $122.57–128.95，成交量为平均水平的 1.7 倍。股价位于下行的 5 日（$131.2）、10 日（$138.8）、30 日（$150.0）和 100 日均线（$165.0）以及上行的 200 日均线（$154.5）下方。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方，且在零轴之下；抛物线 SAR 自 10月12日起看空（$149.71），RSI 为 33。

read.en: The drop broke the $132.75 and $127.6 supports, now resistance, and closed at the $123.9 Mar 19 low. Resistance is $126.7–127.6 (Mar 30 and Oct 20 lows), then $131.2–132.75 (5-day, Oct 15 low) and $138.7. Support is $122.6–123.9, then $120 (Mar 9 low) and $114.5 (Jul 28 low). A close above $127.6 would target $132.75; a close below $122.6 would open $120.
